requirement.statement: The host workspace SHALL resolve every direct depa-data-graph core and Solid dependency to the upstream unified 1.0.1 release line, and its boundary guard SHALL describe the current public API rather than removed projection APIs or stale package topology.

case.given: Cell and terminal packages directly depend on depa-data-graph core or Solid
case.then: every direct manifest SHALL request the 1.0.1 release line and bun.lock SHALL resolve core and Solid without a legacy 0.1.x entry

case.given: the target package exposes unified DataGraph state-node and timeline foundations
case.when: the vendor data-graph boundary test runs
case.then: it SHALL require supported generic exports and SHALL NOT require removed ReducerProjection or createReducerProjection exports
it SHALL locate current AI-specific source ownership paths rather than stale package topology
